Diablo 5 To Launch With More Classes Than Any Other in the Franchise | Blizzcon 2026
We sat down with the development team for Diablo 5 to discuss what to expect when the game launches in 2029. In this video, we chat with Blizzard about how Diablo 5 will affect the ongoing development for Diablo 4, how the itemization is Diablo 5 seeks to return to franchise roots, and how Diablo taking the center stage affects the moment-to-moment of Diablo 5 gameplay.

text:
Diablo 4 Has No Signs of Slowing Down Despite Diablo 5 - Blizzcon 2026
We sat down with the creative director and sesaons lead for Diablo 4 to catch up on all the news that was announced for the game during Blizzcon 2026. Even though Diablo 5 is on the horizon, the developers behind Diablo 4 have assured they have no intentions on slowing down updates for the game. With Diable 4 Season 15: Hell's Legacy right around the corner, and the much requested Amazon Class looming not too far off, Blizzard aims to prove Diablo 4 has a lot of life left to give.

text:
Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Lance Boosted Action Trailer
Check out the Lance Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Lance and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring the slam & charge with the Boost Driver, sending back hits with greater force, and high-velocity pokes. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

text:
New StarCraft Gameplay Details & a Promised Release Date
After all these years, Blizzard is finally ready to bring us a new StarCraft game... in 2030. But history shows that Blizzard can be a bit lose with their release dates, especially ones that are so far out. However, creative director Dan Hay is very confident that StarCraft will indeed release on time in 2030. Plus, we hear about how the game is shaping and god teases of what we can expect the game might play like.

text:
Diablo Himself Returns in Diablo 4 | Season 15 Gameplay
You don't have to wait until Diablo 5 and its 2029 release date to face off against Diablo, the Lord of Terror. Instead, Diablo 4's Season 15 seeks to inject a bit of nostalgia by bringing all three prime evils together in a sort of boss rush mode. Take a trip down memory lane as Deckard Cain makes a surprise comeback to talk Diablo lore as you descened through hell to face off against Diablo.

Minecraft - Official Transformers Add-On Trailer
Check out the Transformers Add-On Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation adventure game developed by Mojang. Players will be able to morph into one of 12 characters, including Optimus Prime and Megatron, each with unique abilities, weapons, and vehicles. Take on players in three different battle modes, like Deathmatch or Last Man Standing. The Transformers Add-On is available now on Minecraft.

Alkimya: House of Wisdom - Official Announcement Trailer
Check out the Alkimya: House of Wisdom announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person survival horror game set in the House of Wisdom during the 1258 siege of Baghdad. Scavenge for resources, craft alchemical flasks, unlock an interconnected sanctum of Golden Age puzzles, and survive the Mongol invaders — and the cosmic horror waiting beneath them. Alkimya: House of Wisdom will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) and PlayStation.

World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
Discover the secrets of Azeroth’s newest playable race, harness powers yet unseen, and take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever - Official New Horizons Cinematic Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
Built as a new permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, World of Warcraft: Forever invites past, current, and new players into a familiar yet fresh Azeroth where the world takes center stage, community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination. Set after the events of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom and before Molten Core, players will return to the original continents, adventure to level 60, and continue progressing through new stories, experiences, and updates inspired by years of player passion and feedback. World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, with beta beginning Thursday, September 17.

Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Launch Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
For the first time in more than two decades, a new campaign has arrived in Warcraft III: Reforged. Forsaken Kingdom follows the fall of Lordaeron and its transformation into becoming the Undercity, introducing new faces alongside familiar figures, like Sylvanas, as players discover what it truly means to be Forsaken.

text:
World of Warcraft - Official The Last Titan Teaser Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
The Last Titan is more than a return to Northrend—it’s a reflection on generations of courage, sacrifice, and unforgettable deeds across Azeroth. From the Shifting Sands of Ahn’Qiraj to the Frozen Throne, the Worldbreaker, the Burning Legion, and even the realms beyond life and death, heroes have fought time and again to defend our home. As Azeroth calls on us one last time, this next chapter will offer a glimpse at the challenges waiting ahead when more is revealed early next year, after the events of Midnight: Eclipse.

text:
World of Warcraft Midnight: Eclipse - Official Reveal Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
The next major content update for Midnight, Eclipse, brings players face-to-face with Xal’atath as she hovers just within reach of her ultimate objective: the Worldsoul. With Azeroth’s fate hanging in the balance, players will need to confront her directly and stop her from claiming victory. The events of Eclipse will unfold in the worldcore, setting the stage for a revelation and conflict that will carry the Worldsoul Saga toward its final chapter in The Last Titan.
